description:
Stoneybatter Place offers high-quality en-suite rooms and studio apartments in a secure, modern residence located in one of Dublin’s most popular and well-connected neighbourhoods. With TU Dublin Grangegorman just minutes away and Trinity College approximately 2km away, the property is ideally positioned for student life across the city. There is also a direct bus route serving UCD, making it a practical option for students commuting to campus. 

The area is known for its vibrant atmosphere, with a wide range of cafés, restaurants, and local amenities on the doorstep. It is also very well connected by bus and the Luas Red Line, providing a short and convenient commute to Dublin City Centre and easy access to both the north and south of the city.

Residents benefit from fully furnished rooms, in-unit laundry, and access to a wide range of on-site amenities, including a gym, study rooms, social lounges, and a games area.

A range of private en-suite rooms are available from 5th September for 39-week and full-year bookings, with prices from €303 per week.
Prices quoted exclude a fixed weekly service charge of €48, which covers electricity, internet, waste, and on-site services.

Please note: Room availability can fluctuate, and options may vary throughout the year.

There is currently strong demand for studio apartments, and a waiting list is in operation.

Rooms are also available for shorter-term bookings over the summer months at the rate outlined above.
